subject.title: Feature Request: Add Anthropic native web search (web_search_20260209) as a search provider

question: Should OpenClaw support Anthropic native web_search as a first-class Anthropic plugin/provider feature now, and what opt-in policy should govern hosted search, filters, billing visibility, and result replay?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the implementation adds provider-hosted web access and new config/auth/session semantics that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design gated Anthropic native search
options.body: Define an explicit Anthropic plugin/transport opt-in for native web_search with provider selection, domain/location/max-use controls, result replay handling, docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Fold into the broad server-tools tracker
options.body: Keep this issue as the narrow slice but wait for the broader Anthropic server-tools design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/23353 before accepting code.

options.title: Defer Anthropic native search
options.body: Keep current managed providers and document Gemini/OpenAI/Codex alternatives until maintainers want Anthropic-hosted search in core-bundled plugins.

recommendation.title: Design gated Anthropic native search
recommendation.body: Define an explicit Anthropic plugin/transport opt-in for native web_search with provider selection, domain/location/max-use controls, result replay handling, docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across Anthropic transport, plugin registration, manifest policy, and prior review context for this boundary.
